# The process dies while a command step of a round item runs. Someone removes the worktree. The next run resumes the item and makes the worktree again at the commit that the run started on, here the tip of the base, before the step runs again.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main
exec git -C origin rev-parse integration/r1
cp stdout base-tip

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
subst flow/round.star

exec beehestreal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehestreal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star &
waitfile started
kill -KILL
wait

# The worktree is gone while no run is alive.
exists state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1
rm state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1
! exists state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1
cp base-tip second

exec beehestreal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
stdout 'item round/integration/r1 finished'

# The step ran again in a worktree that holds the tip of the base, detached.
cmp second.head base-tip
grep '^base marker$' second.marker
grep '^detached$' second.mode

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "work", run = ["sh", "-c", "if [ -e @WORK@/second ]; then git rev-parse HEAD > @WORK@/second.head; cat BASE_MARKER > @WORK@/second.marker; git symbolic-ref -q HEAD > /dev/null && echo branch > @WORK@/second.mode || echo detached > @WORK@/second.mode; else echo x > @WORK@/started; sleep 20; fi"])
